qualification.details: Officers of Organized Group 'A' Accounts Services (Indian Audit and Accounts Service, Indian Defence Accounts Service, Indian Railway Accounts Service, Indian Civil Accounts Service, Indian P&T Accounts & Finance Service and Indian Cost Accounts Service) and applicants from the Central Government, Armed Forces of the Union or All India Services working at an appropriate level are exempted from the above qualification. They must have the relevant experience given in Para (ii) of the experience criteria. | General: at least five years of cumulative experience at a senior level during the last ten years in Corporate Financial Management/Corporate Accounts in an organization of repute. Applicants from Organized Group 'A' Accounts Services and from Central Government/Armed Forces of the Union/All India Services: either (a) the educational qualification of Chartered accountancy, cost accountancy or MBA/PGDM with Finance specialization, with at least five years of cumulative senior-level experience in the last ten years in Financial Management/accounts in Government/Corporate Financial Management/Corporate Accounts; or (b) at least five years of cumulative senior-level experience in the last ten years in Corporate Financial Management/Corporate Accounts. | On the date of application and on the date of interview, the applicant must be employed in a regular capacity, not contractual or ad-hoc, in one of the following: | a Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), including a full-time functional Director on the Board of a CPSE; Central Government Group 'A' officers, including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services, and officers from Public Sector Banks, Financial Institutions or Autonomous Bodies; a State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) with annual turnover of Rs.750 crore or more; a private sector company, Joint Venture (JV) or National/State level Cooperative Federation with annual turnover of Rs.750 crore or more. Preference is given to listed private companies, and these applicants are arranged in order of annual turnover. | Turnover means the average audited annual turnover of the three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised. | CPSE: the minimum length of service in the eligible scale is one year for internal candidates and two years for others, as on the date of vacancy. Central Government Group 'A' officers including AIS and Autonomous Bodies: a post at the level of Director in Govt. of India or an equivalent post with equivalent pay scale, held substantively on the date of application. An officer drawing the eligible scale only through Non-Functional Upgradation (NFU) or Next Below Rule (NBR), without a substantive post, is not eligible. Public Sector Banks/Financial Institutions: Board level, or the level immediately below Board level for one year, on the date of application. Armed Forces of the Union: Brigadier in the Army or equivalent rank in Navy/Air Force on the date of application. State PSEs, private companies, JVs and Federations: Board level, or the level immediately below Board level, on the date of application. | Central Government officers, including Armed Forces, All India Services and officers from Public Sector Banks, Financial Institutions and Autonomous Bodies, are considered only on immediate absorption basis. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

selection_process: The Board reserves the right to shortlist applicants for interview
keeping in view the extant guidelines issued from time to time. Applicants must be in regular employment on the date of interview as well. The notice gives no interview date and no marking scheme.
how_to_apply: Fill up the application form online only, against this Job Description, on the PESB website https://pesb.gov.in/.
Give the undertaking, as part of the application, that you will join the post if selected. Without it the application is rejected.
Have the application forwarded online by your nodal officer or competent authority through the proper channel. A link for registration of nodal officers/competent authorities is on the PESB website.
Private company applicants apply directly to PESB and attach the documents listed below.
Attach the vigilance profile in the 13 points proforma prescribed by CVC (circular number 10/09/24 dated 06.09.2024) where the forwarding rules require it.
Submit the application by 03:00 PM on 07.12.2026. The forwarding authority must forward it by 05:00 PM on 16.12.2026.
Group 'A' Central Government officers, including Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services: through the Cadre Controlling Authority.
Officers from Public Sector Banks/Financial Institutions/Autonomous Bodies: through their Administrative Ministry/Department of the Govt. of India.
CMDs/MDs/Functional Directors in CPSE: through the concerned Administrative Ministry/Department.
Below Board level in CPSE: through the concerned CPSE.
CMDs/MDs/Functional Directors in State PSE: through the concerned Administrative Secretary and Cadre Controlling Authority, if any, of the State Government.
Below Board level in SPSE: through the concerned SPSE.
JVs/Federations: through their Nodal Officer/Competent Authority.
Private companies: directly to PESB.

Annual reports of the three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised, of the organisation where currently working (URL or copies), for private company/JV/Federation applicants.
Documentary proof that the company is listed (URL or copies), for private company applicants.
Evidence of working at Board level or at least one level below Board level.
Self-attested copies of documents in support of age and qualifications.
Details of relevant jobs handled in the past.
Vigilance profile in the 13 points CVC proforma.
important_instructions: Applications forwarded to PESB in physical form or through e-mail are rejected. Incomplete applications and applications not received online within the stipulated date are rejected. No application is entertained under any circumstances after the stipulated date. Cadre controlling authorities and competent authorities forward only applications of applicants who are clear from the vigilance angle, as per DPE guidelines (latest OM No. 15(2)/2001-DPE(GM)-FTS-4199 dated 28.10.2025). Central Government candidates, including Armed Forces and All India Services, and officers from Public Sector Banks, Financial Institutions and Autonomous Bodies: if unwilling to join after the interview or after the offer of appointment, they are debarred for two years from the date of interview or offer from consideration for a Board level post in any CPSE. CPSE candidates face the same two-year debarment, but only for Board level posts in CPSEs other than their own. SPSE, private sector, JV and Federation candidates face the same two-year debarment for Board level posts in any CPSE. No request for relaxation or otherwise is entertained in these cases. All communications go to the Secretary, Public Enterprises Selection Board, Public Enterprises Bhawan, Block No. 14, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.

content_sections.heading: About BVFCL
content_sections.text: Brahmaputra Valley Fertilizer Corporation Limited was incorporated in 2002 under the Indian Companies Act, 1956 to de-merge the Namrup I, II and III plants from Hindustan Fertilizer Corporation Ltd. It produces urea fertilizer and is a CPSE with the Government of India holding 100 per cent shares as on 31 March 2026. The notice says it employed 365 regular employees (Executives 257 and Non-Executives 108) as on 31 March 2026.

content_sections.heading: BVFCL Director (Finance) Job Description 2026
content_sections.text: Director (Finance) is a member of the Board of Directors and reports to the Chairman and Managing Director. The Director (Finance) is overall in charge of finance and accounts of the organization. The role is responsible for evolving and formulating policies relating to finance and accounts and for their implementation.

content_sections.text: The appointment is for five years from the date of joining, or up to the date of superannuation, or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BVFCL Director (Finance)?
faq.answer: Applicants must apply online by 03:00 PM on 07.12.2026. The forwarding authority must forward applications to PESB by 05:00 PM on 16.12.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for BVFCL Director (Finance)?
faq.answer: The applicant should be a Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant or have a full time MBA/PGDM with specialization in Finance from a recognized University/Institution, with preference to Chartered Accountant. Certain Central Government and Accounts Service officers are exempted from this qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 40 years. The maximum is 2 years of residual service for internal applicants and 3 years for others, as on the date of vacancy, with superannuation at 60 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for BVFCL Director (Finance)?
Q5. How is the selection done?
faq.answer: The Board reserves the right to shortlist applicants for interview, keeping in view the extant guidelines issued from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the application form online on https://pesb.gov.in/, and your nodal officer or competent authority then forwards it online. Private company applicants apply directly to PESB. Physical or e-mail applications are rejected.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Only applicants in regular, not contractual or ad-hoc, employment on the date of application and the date of interview. The employer can be a CPSE, a Central Government Group 'A' service, a PSB/Financial Institution/Autonomous Body, an SPSE or a private company, JV or Federation (the last two with annual turnover of Rs.750 crore or more).

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for five years from the date of joining, or up to the date of superannuation, or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if a selected candidate declines to join?
faq.answer: A candidate unwilling to join after the interview or after the offer of appointment is debarred for two years from consideration for a Board level post in CPSEs. For CPSE candidates this covers CPSEs other than their own.
